name: Red or Green
summary:
Red or Green is a free French-language browser party game about "red flags" and "green flags", the warning signs and good signs people spot in dating, relationships and friendships. Players need no account and play anonymously; every vote feeds community rankings of which behaviours count as red or green flags.

It gathers several short games: a Red Flag Test that scores the player's own traits against the community's votes, "C'est un 10 mais…" in which players rate flawed profiles on a scale running up to 15/10, "Le pire des deux", where two behaviours face off and the player picks the more serious one, and "L'Oracle", where an AI gives its verdict on a situation the player describes. It is played on phones and computers, alone or with friends, and also links to self-assessment tools about healthy relationships such as a "violentomètre" and a "consentomètre".
